pick.name: GitHub Issues + Projects
pick.what: Issues, milestones and Projects boards/tables/roadmaps next to the code
pick.why: Claude Code already drives it through gh CLI and the GitHub MCP; no issue cap; issues link to PRs and releases, which double as your public changelog
pick.free_limits: Included on GitHub Free; up to 50 fields per project; 50,000 items per project (GitHub changelog Feb 2025)

alts.name: Linear (Free)
alts.what: Fast keyboard-first issue tracker with official remote MCP
alts.why: Best UX and cycles/roadmaps; official MCP (claude mcp add --transport http linear-server https://mcp.linear.app/mcp); flips when you add a collaborator who lives outside GitHub
alts.free_limits: Free: 250 issues total, 2 teams, unlimited members, 10 MB uploads; Basic $10/user/mo (annual)

alts.name: Todoist (Beginner)
alts.what: Personal task manager with official hosted MCP (ai.todoist.net/mcp)
alts.why: Best for non-code personal/admin tasks captured from phone; Doist ships an official MCP (todoist-ai v13.7.1 2026-10-27)
alts.free_limits: Free: 5 personal projects, 3 filter views, 5 MB uploads, no calendar layout or custom reminders; Pro $5/mo annual

candidates.name: GitHub Issues + Projects
candidates.verdict: PICK: zero extra tool, unlimited, native to Claude Code workflow

candidates.name: Linear Free
candidates.verdict: Best UX + MCP but 250-issue cap bites fast for a multi-product solo founder

candidates.name: Todoist
candidates.verdict: Great for personal errands; 5-project cap; not where code work belongs

candidates.name: TickTick
candidates.verdict: Free: 9 lists, 99 tasks/list; Premium $49.99/yr; good habit+pomodoro but no official MCP

candidates.name: Super Productivity
candidates.verdict: Used below as the daily planner that imports GitHub issues, not as the backlog

decision: Keep the product backlog where the code and Claude Code already are: GitHub Issues + Projects, free and uncapped. Linear is the better tracker UX and has an official MCP, but the 250-issue free cap is the trigger; switch when you hire or have a client/PM who needs a non-GitHub view (Basic $10/user/mo). Personal non-code tasks go in the daily planner slot.
details: Use one private 'ops' repo for non-product founder tasks (sales, compliance, admin) so everything is in one gh query.

verify.note: GitHub Projects item cap is 50,000 (raised from 1,200 in 2025); docs page itself does not state it; gh winget ID fine.
